# html2realpdf

> html2realpdf is an open-source, browser-first HTML-to-PDF library that generates native, selectable, searchable, vector-based PDF documents instead of whole-page screenshots.

## Primary links

- Repository: https://github.com/imggion/html2realpdf
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@imggion/html2realpdf
- CSS support: https://github.com/imggion/html2realpdf/blob/main/docs/css-support.md
- License: MIT

## Technical summary

- Written in Zig and compiled to WebAssembly.
- Ships a typed TypeScript API.
- Accepts HTML strings, DOM elements, and mounted framework refs.
- Keeps text selectable and searchable, links as PDF annotations, embedded font subsets, and supported graphics as vectors.
- Runs in modern browsers and supports React and Vue integration through the DOM boundary.
- Provides an html2pdf.js-style compatibility builder for common migration workflows.

## Install

`npm install @imggion/html2realpdf`
